messages:
maria: quick triage — after last night's RBAC prune we saw keystore fetch errors in eu-west and us-west. mTLS handshakes falling back.
josh: are customers affected?
maria: minimal, some internal retries and proxy 5xx spikes.
kevin: KMS audit shows PermissionDenied on Decrypt right when prune ran. sample: `decrypt failed: code=7 PermissionDenied`.
anika: which binding got removed?
maria: infra-keystore-readers was removed from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter across projects.
josh: root cause: prune removed group that key material depended on. keystore couldn't decrypt, returned 500, proxy aborted mTLS.
sre-oncall: incident threshold is 1% mTLS failures for 10m. we hit ~0.9% for ~8m. monitoring kept it under incident.
maria: mitigations considered: rollback group binding (fast), grant scoped decrypt to keystore SA (preferred), cache previous key material as short-term.
kevin: I'll add an alert rule for KMS Decrypt DENY spikes and a detection query for audit logs.
anika: add a dry-run check to prune pipeline: simulate affected SAs for cloudkms.decrypt permission. block prune if simulation fails.
josh: action items: 1) scoped SA grant PR (maria), 2) alert + dashboard panel (kevin), 3) prune dry-run impl (anika), 4) postmortem (maria + anika).
security-bot: [alert] KMS decrypt deny spike detected — follow-up required.
maria: creating PR for scoped grant and assigning infra-admin for quick approval. will update when merged.
